tips.title: Thinning Vallejo Model Air vs Model Color
tips.text: Vallejo Model Air requires for airbrushing. For Model Color, mix at a 1:1 ratio with Vallejo Airbrush Thinner. Add 2-3 drops of Vallejo Flow Improver per 10 drops of thinned paint. Spray Model Air at 1.5-2 bar pressure, Model Color at 1.0-1.5 bar.

tips.title: Base Coat Technique with Tamiya Acrylics
tips.text: Mix Tamiya Acrylic paint with Tamiya Acrylic Thinner at a 2:1 ratio for a smooth base coat. Apply two thin coats, letting each coat dry for 10-15 minutes. Lightly sand between coats with 12000 grit sandpaper for a smooth finish.

tips.title: Masking Camouflage Patterns
tips.text: Use Tamiya Masking Tape to mask off panel lines and create camouflage patterns. Apply tape firmly and use a sharp blade to trim excess. Seal edges with Mr. Hobby Mr. Mark Softer to prevent paint bleeding. Airbrush Vallejo Model Color at 1.5 bar pressure.

tips.title: Applying AK Interactive Washes
tips.text: Shake AK Interactive Washes well before use. Apply thinly with a brush, working from the top down. Allow to pool in recesses. After 5 minutes, remove excess with a clean, damp brush. Let dry completely before handling.

tips.title: Chipping with Sponge Technique
tips.text: Mix Vallejo Acrylic paint with Vallejo Airbrush Thinner at a 1:1 ratio for the chipping effect color. Lightly dab a damp, natural sea sponge onto the paint to create chips. Apply paint sparingly, focusing on edges and high-wear areas. Allow to dry completely.
